name: 花萃滋润淡香沐浴露款

shots.intent: 首屏以花境与干净瓶身赢得点击，顶部留出标题位
用四格真实质感放大干燥粗糙暗哑的沐浴痛点，引出产品
以微距乳液质地与花瓣证明滋润亲肤的质感
背影使用场景代入真实沐浴时刻，产品仍是主角
深玫红收口氛围配空白按钮位，促成下单动作

style.backgroundSystem: draped blush rose-pink silk #F6E3E7 for the hero, clean ivory #FBF6F1 for info shots, deep wine-red #6E2440 stage for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and empty circular badge frames only, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front-left key, soft contact shadows, delicate warm glow, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft floral body-cleansing ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of blush rose-pink #F6E3E7, ivory white #FBF6F1, magenta-rose accent #C2417B and deep wine-red #6E2440; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front-left key, soft contact shadows and delicate petal-strewn styling; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright pump-bottle presentation at a consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright pump-bottle presentation at a consistent scale, centered hero placement
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm stone shelf #EDE4DA and silk drape, scattered fresh rose petals
